what: Controls for scripts/measure_fairness.py -- the rule 8 fairness measurement. Both directions are exercised: a planted gap must be found, and 200 null draws must stay near alpha.

controls.name: W1
controls.expects: every Wilson endpoint solves its defining equation

controls.name: W2
controls.expects: 10/10 does not certify perfection: the lower bound stays well below 1 while the upper bound reaches 1 to floating-point tolerance

controls.name: W3
controls.expects: n=0 returns (None, None) rather than a number

controls.name: F1
controls.expects: tea-tasting table reproduces the published p = 0.485714

controls.name: F2
controls.expects: p is invariant under transpose and under swapping both rows

controls.name: F3
controls.expects: agrees with scipy on 200 random tables to 1e-9

controls.name: F4
controls.expects: an empty arm gives p = 1.0, never a spurious finding

controls.name: F5
controls.expects: a perfectly separated 25v25 table is overwhelmingly significant

controls.name: H1
controls.expects: adjusted p-values are non-decreasing in raw order

controls.name: H2
controls.expects: the smallest raw p is multiplied by the family size

controls.name: H3
controls.expects: Holm can REMOVE significance, not merely relabel it: raw 0.02 in a family of 7 crosses 0.05

controls.name: B1
controls.expects: non-ASCII detection: Jose ASCII; Jose-with-acute, Cyrillic and a CJK name not ASCII; an apostrophe stays ASCII

controls.name: B2
controls.expects: token buckets are 1 / 2 / 3+ and ignore padding whitespace

controls.name: B3
controls.expects: surface normalisation folds case and collapses whitespace

controls.name: B4
controls.expects: the seen-set finds a planted name and misses one that is absent

controls.name: B5
controls.expects: the seen-set's type filter holds: a `company` span is NOT collected as a person name

controls.name: S1
controls.expects: a fully masked gold span is not a leak

controls.name: S2
controls.expects: a PARTIALLY masked gold span still counts as a leak

controls.name: S3
controls.expects: an unmasked gold span is a leak

controls.name: S4
controls.expects: a predicted span whose type is not in the redaction policy provides no coverage

controls.name: P1
controls.expects: a planted 100%-vs-0% gap is found, with the right sign

controls.name: P2
controls.expects: 200 null draws at an identical 0.13 leak rate stay near alpha=0.05, not above it

controls.name: P3
controls.expects: swapping the arms flips the gap and leaves p unchanged

controls.name: P4
controls.expects: a 40-point gap on n=5 per arm does NOT reach significance -- small n cannot manufacture a finding

controls.name: I1
controls.expects: a corrupted reference makes the run REFUSE and exit non-zero

controls.name: I2
controls.expects: the true reference passes, reporting reproduction over all 25 per-type cells

controls.name: E1
controls.expects: no identifier surface from the corpus appears in the evidence file, other than strings that are also in the script's own source
controls.detail: 1961 surfaces searched, 1 substring hits, 0 unexplained, carve-outs ['person']

controls.name: E2
controls.expects: the E1 checker, handed a planted surface, finds it and had not already been reporting it -- so E1 is not passing vacuously
controls.detail: planted a 19-char surface; 2 new hit(s), all substrings of it: True

controls.name: E3
controls.expects: every carve-out is recoverable by the same search with the exemption off, so the exemption -- not a blind spot -- is what suppressed it
